question: Groundwater is an important source of water. The top level of the groundwater layer is called:
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Water Table**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **water table** is the upper surface of the groundwater layer where soil and rock are completely saturated with water.
 
• Below the **water table**, all the spaces between soil particles and rocks are filled with water, forming the saturated zone.
 
• The **water table** fluctuates depending on factors such as **rainfall, usage of groundwater, and seasonal changes**.
 
• The depth of the **water table** varies across regions, influenced by geological formations, climate, and human
